entries.en: at the right time; timely, in season
a long time
long-lasting; of long standing

entries.zh: 时节景象；时下的天气光景
entries.en: this present time and season; the look of the season (weather)

entries.zh: 气候温和；调燮阴阳（语本「燮理阴阳」，谓调和阴阳、四时平顺）
entries.en: temperate (weather); ms. lit. 'to harmonise yin and yang'
entries.notes: 汉字首字有「燮/癉」两读[疑]，依西语 templado（温和）与音写 sien 取「燮」立义。

entries.zh: 好天时；天气晴好、天时正宜
entries.en: fine weather; a fitting, favourable season
can be returned, may be repaid (Spanish headword corrupted: 'fuera/pfagan' strings intruded from other lemmas; gloss follows the Chinese 可还)
entries.notes: 西语词头串讹（fuera/pfagan 诸式羼入，疑窜自他条），en 无法依西语定锚，仅据汉字「可还」与音写 tang-huān 立义。

entries.en: a fixed, determined time

entries.zh: 霜降（节气名，霜始降之时）
entries.en: Frost's Descent (solar term, when frost first falls; Sp. 'yela' = hiela, it freezes)
the frosty season: frost, cold, snow and freezing weather
just in time; right at the proper season

entries.zh: 著时；合乎时令、正着其时
entries.en: well-timed; fitting the season
in season; timely
to hasten to the season; to avail oneself of the right time
entries.notes: 音写另载 hù xit 一式而无对应汉字（自动重构注「?」，或为「赴日/赴一」），仅据汉字「赴时」立义。

entries.zh: 一任；官吏任期一届（亦通「听凭、任其」之义）
entries.en: one term (of office), one tenure (headword in L disputed: 'invierno' vs 'registro', mismatching the Chinese)
entries.notes: 西语词头 invierno/registro 两读未决[疑]，且「invierno（冬）」与汉字「一任」不相应，zh/en 依汉字与音写 chit-xim 立义。

entries.en: shop, store
shop, store (舖 = 铺)

entries.zh: 坎（坑坎、土坎；列于「店」条下，所指待考）
entries.en: pit, hollow, earthen ridge (坎); listed under tienda, sense link uncertain
entries.notes: 西语 "numeral ~" 无从确解，坎与 tienda 之义关联待考，依汉字与音写 kam 立义。

entries.zh: 铺舍；铺屋、店铺房舍（旧亦指驿铺屋舍）
entries.en: shop premises, shop-house; (also) relay-station lodge

entries.zh: 坎店（坎＝坑坎、崖坎；坎地所设之店，组合义待考）
entries.en: shop in a hollow/pit (坎店); compound referent uncertain
entries.notes: 坎店组合义不见通行词书，依字面（坎地设店）立义，待考。

entries.en: shopkeeper; shop, establishment
firm, steadfast; prudent, careful (ms. gloss: moderate, modest, careful)
entries.notes: 词头含讹缩 "fenertienn"，释义依其后自注 moderado/modesto/cuidadoso 与汉字「慎」。
